meaning:
(Hiphil) to break, crush
Another spelling of pa.rar (פָּרַר "to break" H6565A)

elsewhere.note: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
“Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.
